g.text: Aisle width is not a preference: head length + load + about 12 in to manoeuvre, load face to load face.
The pallet is 48 in deep on a 42 in upright, so 3 in hangs over the beam front and back.
One bay is filled in and one aisle dimensioned; repeating them would cover the drawing in figures.
Building, racks and equipment are fictional.
more pallet positions per sq ft
